Application Description

Have you ever wanted to become the villain of a story? Legend of Keepers is a mix between rogue-lite and dungeon management, where you play as a dungeon manager hiring monsters and building traps to defeat the heroes coming for your gold. Well, the Dungeons Company is looking for its new Boss and needs you to protect their treasures! You have to experience every company’s struggles in this fantasy workspace simulation, from sick leaves to strikes, and manage your team to run the most impenetrable dungeon! In this "reverse-Darkest Dungeon", climb the corporate ladder and optimize your strategy to become the most fearsome (and, perhaps, respected) boss in dungeon history! Main Features - Deal with the trials of corporate life: mix and match your roster of bloodthirsty employees to stay on top of the dungeon business - Don’t play nice for once: be the bad guy and make those smug heroes pay with your mischievous strategies - Manage your resource budget: On top of morale, gold, blood, and tears must be spent wisely in this economy. - Being bad never looked this good: see your enemies perish in drop-dead gorgeous animations. Watch out for stains! - Diversify your management styles: Play as 3 dungeon masters - each with their own abilities and recruits - through various campaigns *NEW MASTERS, NEW ENVIRONMENTS, NEW MONSTERS!* Unlock the three DLCS : Return Of The Goddess, Feed The Troll and Soul Smugglers. Buy them separately, or together with the DLC Bundle. One of the best hack-and-slash games of all time now fits in your pocket! Originally released on PC in 2006, Titan Quest is an action RPG set against a mythological backdrop. The Titans have escaped from prison and are hell-bent on destroying the Earth. The Gods alone can’t stop them -- a hero is needed to lead this epic struggle. Victory or defeat will determine humanity’s fate and that of the Olympians. You are that hero! Create your character, explore ancient civilizations like Greece, Egypt, Babylon, and China, and fight against hordes of legendary creatures! Master the arts of archery, swordsmanship or magic and upgrade your character to unlock awesome powers! Discover special items to help you complete your quest: legendary swords, devastating thunderbolts, enchanted bows, and much more! Mixing ancient mythology with non-stop action, Titan Quest is a classic hack-and-slash offering energizing gameplay with a fast, intense rhythm. Overcome thrilling challenges and vanquish the greatest enemies ever to invade the mobile world! DLCs available as in-app purchase: ● IMMORTAL THRONE - Encounter the greatest villains of Greek mythology, brave the attacks of Cerberus, and hazard the banks of the River Styx to conquer this dark new adventure. ● RAGNARÖK - In the uncharted lands of northern Europe, you’ll brave the realms of the Celts, the Northmen, and the Asgardian gods! ● ATLANTIS - Set out on a journey across the western Mediterranean, in search of the mythical kingdom of Atlantis. entry.title: Neighbours back From Hell
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：₺89,99 → ₺29,99 [₺5,00 ~ ₺89,99]）

All Price Information

Price：₺29,99

Application Description

Did you know that “Schadenfreude” is a German word defined as the concept of finding joy in someone else’s misfortune? It is also the main idea on which Neighbours back From Hell is built. A whole TV show based on playing increasingly outrageous pranks on your grumpy neighbour to keep the audience entertained and viewership numbers high. It’s good to be bad in this early 2000s trash TV-inspired slapstick extravaganza! As Woody, the vengeful star protagonist, you will prank your way through Seasons 1 and 2 of this fictitious, but aptly named TV show. Take the mischief from your nasty neighbour’s flat all the way to China, India, and Mexico where you will make sure his holiday is a living hell. While you’re at it, why limit your antics to your neighbour when you can involve his mother and fellow travellers? Whatever you decide to do, your trusty camera crew will be right there to catch all the action! Let your crooked creativity flow freely and watch the neighbour rage in desperation. Just be mindful not to get caught by him or his companions, or they will whoop you good and your TV show will be taken off the air! If you perform well by creating chaos in the neighbour’s life, ratings will increase, and you could win prestigious awards! Neighbours From Hell 1 & 2 Remastered in one package: 28 episodes set in the neighbour’s home, on a cruise liner, and in several different holiday locations around the world! Key Features: - All graphics newly rendered in Full HD - Framerate of all animations doubled for a smoother experience - Use stealth, skill, and style to perform the perfect ambush - Easy to use interface and controls - Superb cartoon-style graphics - Big band soundtrack - Full controller support

entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：₺139,99 → ₺29,99 [₺5,00 ~ ₺139,99]）

All Price Information

Price：₺29,99

Application Description

IMPORTANT DOES NOT support: iPhone 5S, iPad Air, iPad Mini 2 & 3 and iPod Touch Interpret the law as you see fit in This Is the Police 2, sequel to the acclaimed noir drama This Is the Police! Run the sheriff’s department, manage your cops, investigate, interrogate, and incarcerate. Make tough decisions – and try to keep out of prison yourself! – in this story-driven mixture of adventure, strategy, and turn-based tactical combat. Is it a simulation? A management game? A tactical challenge? A visual novel? A puzzle? It’s all of these, and more! Dive into one-of-a-kind -story-driven experience. Welcome to Sharpwood, a cold and harsh border town riven with violence, where no one is completely innocent. Smugglers, gangs, and screaming populists call this town their home. To maintain peace and order, the young sheriff Lilly Reed (Sarah Hamilton) will have to team up with fugitive criminal Jack Boyd (Jon St. John), and pray that her dangerous plan doesn’t spiral out of control. Take charge of the Sheriff’s department. Your subordinates aren’t just some resource; they are living people with their own strengths, weaknesses, fears, and prejudices – and you'll have to reckon with all of them in order to survive. Is one of your guys drinking too much? Or always coming up with excuses for not coming to work? Or does he refuse to follow orders? You’ll have to show a steady hand if you want to impose discipline on this department. Engage in tactical combat. During your most dangerous operations, the game will switch to turn-based combat. Gather a team of your finest cops. Carefully study the terrain, adapt your plans, stealthily approach your suspects and use non-lethal weapons and equipment – if the situation allows. True, sometimes gunfights are almost impossible to avoid, but be careful: This Is the Police 2 doesn’t have hit points. A single bullet can cost a cop their life. Become a true detective. Collect evidence, study case materials, interrogate suspects and send the criminals to court. And if the suspect was innocent? Perhaps it's time to find out if any Sharpwood judges can be bought. Thank you for playing ‘THIS IS THE POLICE 2’! entry.title: Solar Arc: Golden Hour Tracker
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：₺199,99 → Free [Free ~ ₺299,99]）

All Price Information

Price：Free

Application Description

Golden hour happens every single day. Most people miss it. SolarArc makes sure you don't. - Chasing golden hour for a photo? Know the exact minute it starts. - Planning a sunrise hike? See the best trail windows at a glance. - Wondering when the moon rises tonight? It's right there on your screen. SolarArc is a sun and moon tracker that feels like looking out the window. Every view shifts with the real sky - warm when the light is warm, dark when the sky is dark. THE GRADIENT LINE Your entire day, painted in one line. Dawn amber bleeds into midday blue, then sunset orange, then deep navy night. Golden hour glows. Blue hour cools. You can read the exact times, or just glance at the color and know where you are in the day. THE ARC The sun and moon traced across your sky in real time. Watch them rise, climb, and fall against a live gradient that shifts with the actual light outside your window. Drag your finger across the arc to scrub through the day - the sky, the times, and the numbers all move with you. View the sun alone, the moon alone, or both together. THE MOON Know when to look up. SolarArc renders tonight's moon with the correct phase shape on the arc. Plan around full moons. Catch a crescent at dusk. Know exactly how dark the sky will be. 52-WEEK FORECAST What will golden hour look like three Saturdays from now? How much daylight will you have on that hiking trip in April? Pick any date in the next year and see the full picture - sun, moon, and light - before you commit. FIVE WAYS TO USE THE SKY Photography - Golden hour and blue hour, down to the minute. Stop guessing when to shoot. Hiking - Best trail windows and how much daylight is left. Know when to turn around. Screens - A screen curfew that follows the sun. Wind down as the sky does. Gardening - When to water, when to protect, and how many sun hours your plants get today. Stargazing - When true darkness begins. The best window to see everything above you. FEATURES - Live gradient line and arc visualizations - Drag to scrub through any moment of the day - Sun view, moon view, or dual view - Golden hour and blue hour timing - Moonrise, moonset, phase, and illumination - 52-week forecast for any date - Five activity modes - Seven Home Screen widgets: sun and moon, line and arc, medium and large - Notifications for sunrise, sunset, and golden hour - Multi-location with automatic timezone handling - Available in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Korean, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Ukrainian, and Russian - Built on NOAA solar and Meeus lunar algorithms - Fully offline. No tracking. No account required. WHAT IS GOLDEN HOUR? Golden hour is the short window after sunrise and before sunset when the light turns soft, warm, and directional. Photographers chase it. Hikers love it. SolarArc tells you exactly when it happens, wherever you are. EVERYTHING INCLUDED All seven widgets, the 52-week forecast, unlimited saved places, all five modes, and golden hour, sunrise, and sunset alerts. One purchase. No subscription. No ads. No in-app purchases. Made by Spruzzo Labs - a creative lab. Questions or ideas? hello@spruzzolabs.com

Adjust levels, keyboard ranges, MIDI channels, envelopes, EQ, compression and reverb. Per-sound effects include chorus, tremolo, auto pan, drive and Leslie. Master controls provide volume, separate gain up to +9 dB and MIDI Learn. Inside StageLab, the WAVE 3 synthesizer offers oscillator, filter, envelope and effects editing, plus an integrated arpeggiator and sequencer. Explore a bank of 24 ARP/SEQ presets, create your own sounds and save your presets. In the standalone app, WAVE 3 and Live Loops follow the shared metronome. The AUv3 extension lets you use instruments in compatible hosts; Live Loops playback is available only in the standalone app. In AUv3, WAVE 3 retains Local/Host clock options. PadLab Full App includes Live Loops and StageLab, including for existing Full purchasers. WAVE 3 arpeggiator and sequencer are included in StageLab at no additional charge. Previous standalone ARP/SEQ purchasers retain access to their legacy tools. Buying Live Loops alone does not unlock StageLab or all premium drum kits. Other optional sounds, kits and features are offered through in-app purchases. Factory content referenced by a set depends on the library and purchases available on the destination device.
